briefings.tldr: Schneider Electric's Pankaj Sharma explains that scaling AI infrastructure requires solving a critical energy bottleneck through two primary pillars: building more efficient physical infrastructure (such as liquid cooling and digital grids) and deploying "energy intelligence" (using AI algorithms on decades of operational data to optimize energy use and reduce waste).
